newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Human jumps, closes on other Budapest drug stocks.
newsitem.headline: Human jumps, closes on other Budapest drug stocks.

text.p: Shares in Hungarian pharmaceuticals company Human Rt rose on tight supply, news of a major investment, and the fact that its price lagged behind prices of other drug company shares, a trader said.
Human jumped to a record high of 3,780 forints on Monday, before easing a little. At 1036 GMT, Human traded at 3,770 forints, up 160 forint or 4.43 percent from Friday's close.
"It was lagging behind the two other pharmaceuticals in terms of price/earnings," said trader Robert Forgo of MKB Securities. "Now it is catching up with them."
Richter Gedeon Rt and Egis Gyogyszergyar Rt are the two other pharmaceuticals stocks on the Budapest Stock Exchange.
"News of major investments also propelled Human's price and, since liquidity in the share is small, a small buy intention could rapidly drive its price higher," Forgo said.
Human on Friday laid the foundation of a new two billion forint plant to increase its current eight million units of annual capacity of intravenous solutions to 20 million units.
